text:
maya: Quick q — who owns the 'feature sweep' that will flip a bunch of runtime flags tomorrow?
jon: i thought platform was on call for that? cc @harper
harper: platform + product agreed i would coordinate but i need handoff for the telemetry gating. not signed up for sweeping infra side changes
alex_p: can we split ownership? product owns flag semantics, platform owns rollout + telemetry and the API contract
praveen: agreed. also need to confirm we won't change /v1/config schema. last time clients broke.
maya: good catch. harper, can you confirm no schema changes? also we need to add console warning: 'mass flag update in progress — expect transient errors'
harper: no schema changes. only toggles and quota tweaks. i'll drop the console banner and a link to docs.
jon: telemetry: we need per-flag evaluation counts + error rate and a latency percentile. propose sampling at 5% during sweep then ramp to 20% if stable
alex_p: SGTM. make sure sampling is opt-in via runtime param so teams can reduce noise. example API header we use:
```
X-Runtime-Telemetry: sample=0.05
```
maya: what's the rollback plan if latency/regressions spike?
praveen: auto-rollback via config-controller if error_rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms for 3m. ops-bot will announce and create incident channel
harper: i'll own the ops-bot message text and the console banner. alex, can platform add a lightweight preflight that checks config-version parity across control plane and edge caches?
alex_p: yes, can add a preflight check. i'll post a small healthcheck script in the PR.
maya: thanks all. can we sync 09:30 for final go/no-go? :thumbsup:
harper: yes
jon: yep
praveen: on it
ops-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2025-11-02 09:20 UTC
